================================================================================
VENDORS APP — ADMIN API REFERENCE
================================================================================

Base URL   : /
Method     : All endpoints are POST
Auth       : Bearer token (IsAuthenticated)
Envelope   : { "status": true|false, "message": "...", "data": {...}?, "errors": {...}? }

Organization context:
  - All endpoints are scoped to the caller's organization.
  - The view resolves organization from the authenticated user.
  - Do NOT send organization_id — it is ignored.
  - A vendor from another org returns 404, never 403.

Who uses this document:
  - Organization owner (Admin role)
  - Any org member with Admin-level access (typically procurement / accounts)

This app has NO employee-side surface. All 5 endpoints are admin-only.
Vendors are external supplier records — they are not system users and
have no login, no bell, no notifications.


================================================================================
BOOTSTRAP ORDER — READ FIRST
================================================================================

  1. Create a vendor     (/vendors/create/)
  2. Use vendor id in    (whatever module consumes vendors — currently none
                          in the reviewed apps; possibly invoices, purchase
                          orders, or expense entries in future)

  Vendors are standalone. No dependency on client/project/employee exists.
  A vendor can be created with zero downstream references.


================================================================================
SECTION 1 — VENDOR CRUD
================================================================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.1  POST /vendors/create/
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Purpose : Create a new vendor
Type    : application/json (no file uploads in this endpoint)

Request :
{
  "vendor_name": "Acme Supplies",                // required
  "company_name": "Acme Supplies Pvt Ltd",       // optional
  "email": "accounts@acmesupplies.com",          // optional, valid email
  "phone": "9876543210",                          // optional
  "address_line": "123 Industrial Area, Andheri", // optional
  "state": "Maharashtra",                         // optional
  "district": "Mumbai",                           // optional
  "taluka": "Andheri",                            // optional
  "pincode": "400001",                            // optional, must be 6 digits if provided
  "tax_number": "27AAACT2727Q1ZS",                // optional (GST/TIN)
  "notes": "Prefers email contact"                // optional
}

Response 201:
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Vendor created successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id": 42,
    "vendor_code": "VEN-000042",
    "vendor_name": "Acme Supplies",
    "company_name": "Acme Supplies Pvt Ltd",
    "email": "accounts@acmesupplies.com",
    "phone": "9876543210",
    "address_line": "123 Industrial Area, Andheri",
    "state": "Maharashtra",
    "district": "Mumbai",
    "taluka": "Andheri",
    "pincode": "400001",
    "tax_number": "27AAACT2727Q1ZS",
    "notes": "Prefers email contact",
    "is_active": true,
    "created_at": "2026-11-16T10:00:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-11-16T10:00:00Z"
  }
}

Response 400 (validation — pincode not 6 digits):
{
  "status": false,
  "message": "Validation failed.",
  "errors": {
    "pincode": ["Pincode must be 6 digits."]
  }
}

Response 400 (validation — pincode has non-digits):
{
  "status": false,
  "message": "Validation failed.",
  "errors": {
    "pincode": ["Pincode must contain only digits."]
  }
}

Response 400 (no vendor_name):
{
  "status": false,
  "message": "Validation failed.",
  "errors": {
    "vendor_name": ["This field is required."]
  }
}

Response 400 (no active org for caller):
{ "status": false, "message": "<get_user_organization error message>" }

Notes:
  - vendor_code is auto-generated in the format "VEN-NNNNNN" — do NOT
    send it in the request.
  - organization is derived from request.user — do NOT send it.
  - Pincode validation (custom in serializer):
      * must contain only digits (no letters, no special chars)
      * must be exactly 6 digits
      * blank/null is allowed (validation skipped)
  - No file uploads in create — documents are not part of this model.
  - Response uses VendorDetailSerializer (full payload including
    address_line, notes, updated_at).


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.2  POST /vendors/list/
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Purpose : List all active vendors in the caller's organization
Request (all optional):
{
  "search": "acme",              // matches vendor_code, vendor_name, company_name,
                                 //         email, phone, state, district, taluka,
                                 //         pincode, tax_number (icontains)
  "state": "Maharashtra",        // exact match on state field
  "district": "Mumbai",          // exact match on district field
  "taluka": "Andheri"            // exact match on taluka field
}

Response 200:
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Vendors fetched successfully.",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 42,
      "vendor_code": "VEN-000042",
      "vendor_name": "Acme Supplies",
      "company_name": "Acme Supplies Pvt Ltd",
      "email": "accounts@acmesupplies.com",
      "phone": "9876543210",
      "state": "Maharashtra",
      "district": "Mumbai",
      "taluka": "Andheri",
      "pincode": "400001",
      "tax_number": "27AAACT2727Q1ZS",
      "is_active": true,
      "created_at": "2026-11-16T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}

Notes:
  - Only is_active=True vendors of the caller's organization.
  - Sort: created_at DESC (newest first).
  - List serializer does NOT include address_line, notes, or updated_at.
    Only the detail serializer returns those. Use /detail/ for the full
    record.
  - search is substring, case-insensitive, across 10 fields.
  - state / district / taluka are EXACT match (case-insensitive via iexact).
    Different from search — use these for filter chips, not free-text.
  - No pagination — returns full filtered list.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.3  POST /vendors/detail/
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Purpose : Full detail of one vendor
Request :
{
  "vendor_id": 42
}

Response 200:
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Vendor details fetched successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id": 42,
    "vendor_code": "VEN-000042",
    "vendor_name": "Acme Supplies",
    "company_name": "Acme Supplies Pvt Ltd",
    "email": "accounts@acmesupplies.com",
    "phone": "9876543210",
    "address_line": "123 Industrial Area, Andheri",
    "state": "Maharashtra",
    "district": "Mumbai",
    "taluka": "Andheri",
    "pincode": "400001",
    "tax_number": "27AAACT2727Q1ZS",
    "notes": "Prefers email contact",
    "is_active": true,
    "created_at": "2026-11-16T10:00:00Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-11-16T10:00:00Z"
  }
}

Response 400 (missing param):
{ "status": false, "message": "vendor_id is required." }

Response 404 (not found / another org / inactive):
{ "status": false, "message": "Vendor not found." }

Notes:
  - Cross-org vendor returns the same 404 as a missing one — no
    information leak.
  - Inactive vendor also returns 404.
  - This endpoint logs a VIEW activity in the audit trail (create /
    update / deactivate log their own actions; this is the only READ
    that logs).


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.4  POST /vendors/update/
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Purpose : Update vendor (partial)
Type    : application/json (no file uploads in this endpoint)

Request (all fields optional; send only what you want to change):
{
  "vendor_id": 42,                                // required
  "vendor_name": "Acme Supplies (Renamed)",
  "company_name": "Acme Supplies Pvt Ltd",
  "email": "hello@acmesupplies.com",
  "phone": "9876543211",
  "address_line": "456 New Industrial Area",
  "state": "Maharashtra",
  "district": "Mumbai",
  "taluka": "Bandra",
  "pincode": "400050",
  "tax_number": "27AAACT2727Q1ZS",
  "notes": "Updated notes"
}

Response 200:
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Vendor updated successfully.",
  "data": { ...full VendorDetailSerializer output... }
}

Response 400 (missing vendor_id):
{ "status": false, "message": "vendor_id is required." }

Response 400 (validation):
{
  "status": false,
  "message": "Validation failed.",
  "errors": {
    "pincode": ["Pincode must be 6 digits."]
  }
}

Response 404 (not found / another org / inactive):
{ "status": false, "message": "Vendor not found." }

Notes:
  - Partial update — any field omitted keeps its current value.
  - vendor_code is IMMUTABLE (auto-generated, not in the update serializer).
  - organization is NOT changeable.
  - is_active is NOT writable here — use /vendors/deactivate/.
  - Same pincode validation rules apply (6 digits, digits only, blank ok).


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.5  POST /vendors/deactivate/
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Purpose : Soft-delete (deactivate) a vendor
Request :
{
  "vendor_id": 42
}

Response 200:
{
  "status": true,
  "message": "Vendor deactivated successfully."
}

Response 400 (missing param):
{ "status": false, "message": "vendor_id is required." }

Response 404 (not found / another org / already inactive):
{ "status": false, "message": "Vendor not found." }

Notes:
  - Soft delete: is_active=False. The row stays in DB.
  - Deactivated vendors disappear from /vendors/list/.
  - Deactivated vendors return 404 from /detail/ and /update/.
  - Any downstream records (e.g. purchase orders, if they existed) are
    NOT affected by the deactivation — FK still points to the now-inactive
    vendor row. No cascading deactivation.
  - No "reactivate" endpoint. Deactivation is terminal for the UI flow.


================================================================================
QUICK REFERENCE — ADMIN ENDPOINTS
================================================================================

VENDOR (5)
  POST /vendors/create/
  POST /vendors/list/
  POST /vendors/detail/
  POST /vendors/update/
  POST /vendors/deactivate/

TOTAL ADMIN ENDPOINTS: 5


================================================================================
DATA SHAPES — FOR UI TYPES
================================================================================

VendorListSerializer (used by /list/):
{
  "id": 42,
  "vendor_code": "VEN-000042",
  "vendor_name": "Acme Supplies",
  "company_name": "Acme Supplies Pvt Ltd",
  "email": "accounts@acmesupplies.com",
  "phone": "9876543210",
  "state": "Maharashtra",
  "district": "Mumbai",
  "taluka": "Andheri",
  "pincode": "400001",
  "tax_number": "27AAACT2727Q1ZS",
  "is_active": true,
  "created_at": "2026-11-16T10:00:00Z"
}
  // NOTE: NO address_line, notes, or updated_at in the list serializer.

VendorDetailSerializer (used by /create/, /detail/, /update/):
  // Same as VendorListSerializer PLUS:
  //   address_line  (string or null)
  //   notes         (string or null)
  //   updated_at    (datetime)
  // Everything else identical.


================================================================================
COMMON ERROR SHAPES
================================================================================

Validation failure (400):
{
  "status": false,
  "message": "Validation failed.",
  "errors": {
    "field_name": ["Error message."]
  }
}

Not found (404):
{ "status": false, "message": "Vendor not found." }

Missing required param (400):
{ "status": false, "message": "vendor_id is required." }

Org context error (400):
{ "status": false, "message": "<get_user_organization error message>" }


================================================================================
KEY NOTES FOR FRONTEND / UI DESIGNER
================================================================================

1. NO FILE UPLOADS IN THIS APP.
   Unlike Clients, Vendors have no documents model and no multipart
   upload. Every endpoint is JSON-only. If you send files, they're
   silently dropped.

2. VENDOR CODE IS IMMUTABLE AND AUTO-GENERATED.
   Format: "VEN-NNNNNN". Display read-only. Never send in create/update.

3. LIST vs DETAIL PAYLOAD DIFFERENCE.
   - List item:    NO address_line, NO notes, NO updated_at.
   - Detail item:  includes address_line, notes, AND updated_at.
   If your list screen needs to show notes or a full address, you must
   call /detail/ per row — or show only the fields present in the list.

4. PINCODE VALIDATION IS STRICT.
   Must be exactly 6 digits (if provided). Non-digits 400. Wrong length
   400. Blank/null allowed. This is the ONLY custom validation in the
   vendor serializer — all other fields accept any value (within model
   length limits).

5. SEARCH vs FILTER IS DIFFERENT.
   - "search": substring match across 10 fields (case-insensitive).
     Good for a single search box.
   - "state" / "district" / "taluka": EXACT match (case-insensitive).
     Good for filter chips or dropdowns. Don't pass partial values here
     — "maha" won't match "Maharashtra" via the state param.
   You can combine them: {"search": "acme", "state": "Maharashtra"}
   narrows results to Acme vendors in Maharashtra.

6. STATE / DISTRICT / TALUKA ARE FREE TEXT.
   Unlike the Location Master app, vendor state/district/taluka are
   just CharFields — not FK references. So a vendor created with
   state="Maharastra" (typo) will NOT match a filter of
   state="Maharashtra". The UI should either:
     - Use the Location Master endpoints for the dropdown values,
       OR
     - Validate/normalize client-side before submit.
   The backend does not enforce any enum.

7. NO PAGINATION.
   /list/ returns the full filtered list. For orgs with many vendors,
   always pass a search term or state filter to keep response small.

8. DEACTIVATION IS SOFT AND TERMINAL.
   No "undo deactivate" endpoint exists. Deactivated vendors disappear
   from lists. If you need to re-enable a vendor, there's no UI path —
   a new vendor must be created.

9. VENDORS ARE NOT SYSTEM USERS.
   No login, no bell, no notifications for vendors. This app does NOT
   trigger any notification. Vendors exist purely as org-scoped records
   for procurement / payables.

10. AUDIT LOG IS SILENT FROM UI PERSPECTIVE.
    Every create/update/deactivate/view is logged to the audit trail,
    but no notification is fired. Admin sees the action in the audit log
    if they look — no bell, no push, no email.


================================================================================
SECTION — VENDOR ACCESS (batch 4)
================================================================================
Missing code -> 403 {"status": false, "message": "You do not have permission to perform this action."}
The organization owner has every code. Codes come from the caller's access role.
  create|update|deactivate/      vendor.manage
  list|detail/                   vendor.manage | expense.manage
